source_conflicts: Body wording, ss.2, 4 and 5: the HTML reads 'District Judge or Commissioner of a Court of Requests*', 'Minister of Justice', 'such Judge or Commissioner*' and 'No such Judge, Commissioner, or Justice'; the 1980 print reads 'District Judge or Judge of a Primary Court', 'Minister in charge of the subject of Justice', 'such Judge or of such Justice' and 'No such Judge or Justice'. The s.2 marginal note differs the same way ('District Judge or Commissioner, & c.' against 'District Judge or Judge of a Primary Court, &c.'). The two held editions therefore disagree on operative wording; the tree follows the HTML. The HTML's two dangling asterisks in s.2 sit exactly where the 1980 print has the newer wording, so they probably marked footnotes about that substitution, but no footnote text survives on the page.
Chain header: HTML '17 of 1852 5 of 1875'; 1980 print 'Nos. 17 of 1852, 0 '' (garbled).
s.5 form of certificate: absent from the HTML (the page runs from 'that is to say,' straight to s.6); printed in the 1980 edition at Vol. IV pp. 124-125.

Title: registry 'Execution of Deeds Ordinance' (the running header, a subject heading); s.1 in both editions cites the 'Deeds and Documents (Execution before Public Officers) Ordinance'. Recorded in the tree's alternate_titles.

Signature A.B.. Seal District Judge.' (text layer reads 'Disirict'). The tree was not changed: the form and the wording question are for the coordinator.
